485: // startDesktop starts the Electron desktop application
486: func (app *ServerApp) startDesktop() error {
487: 	log.Println("Starting KNIRV Desktop...")
488: 
489: 	// Resolve electron binary: ELECTRON_PATH env > node_modules relative to exe > node_modules relative to CWD > PATH
490: 	electronPath := os.Getenv("ELECTRON_PATH")
491: 	if electronPath == "" {
492: 		// Build candidate paths to search
493: 		candidates := []string{filepath.Join("desktop", "node_modules", ".bin", "electron")}
494: 		if exePath, err := os.Executable(); err == nil {
495: 			exeDir := filepath.Dir(exePath)
496: 			// Binary may live at dist/knirv-server; desktop is at ../desktop relative to dist/
497: 			candidates = append(candidates,
498: 				filepath.Join(exeDir, "desktop", "node_modules", ".bin", "electron"),
499: 				filepath.Join(exeDir, "..", "desktop", "node_modules", ".bin", "electron"),
500: 			)
501: 		}
502: 		for _, c := range candidates {
503: 			if abs, err := filepath.Abs(c); err == nil {
504: 				if _, statErr := os.Stat(abs); statErr == nil {
505: 					electronPath = abs
506: 					break
507: 				}
508: 			}
509: 		}
510: 	}
511: 	if electronPath == "" {
512: 		if p, err := exec.LookPath("electron"); err == nil {
513: 			electronPath = p
514: 		}
515: 	}
516: 	if electronPath == "" {
517: 		log.Printf("Warning: Electron not found. Desktop will not be started.")
518: 		log.Printf("Run 'make desktop-build' or set ELECTRON_PATH to the electron binary.")
519: 		return nil
520: 	}
521: 
522: 	// Extract desktop files
523: 	if err := app.extractDesktop(); err != nil {
524: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to extract desktop: %w", err)
525: 	}
526: 
527: 	desktopDir := filepath.Join(app.tempDir, "desktop")
528: 
529: 	// Set the KNIRV server URL for the desktop
530: 	serverUrl := fmt.Sprintf("http://localhost:%d", app.config.Port)
531: 
532: 	// Launch Electron with the desktop.
533: 	// Run electron with the explicit entry point so no package.json is needed.
534: 	// If running under sudo, launch as the original user so Electron has access
535: 	// to the user's display server. We use a login shell to load the user's
536: 	// profile (nvm, etc.) so that node is on PATH.
537: 	mainJsPath := filepath.Join(desktopDir, "main.js")
538: 
539: 	sudoUser := os.Getenv("SUDO_USER")
540: 	if sudoUser != "" {
541: 		// Run as the original user with --set-home so $HOME is correct.
542: 		// Explicitly source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh so node is on PATH regardless of
543: 		// whether nvm is in .bashrc (interactive) or .bash_profile (login).
544: 		// Disable Vulkan/GPU via env vars to suppress driver warnings on headless systems.
545: 		shellCmd := fmt.Sprintf(
546: 			`. "$HOME/.nvm/nvm.sh" 2>/dev/null; `+
547: 				`export XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$(id -u)"; `+
548: 				`export DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/$(id -u)/bus"; `+
549: 				`export VK_ICD_FILENAMES=""; `+
550: 				`export ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=auto; `+
551: 				`KNIRV_SERVER_URL=%s KNIRV_SHUTDOWN_TOKEN=%s KNIRV_SERVER_PORT=%s exec %s --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer %s`,
552: 			shellEscape(serverUrl), shellEscape(app.shutdownToken),
553: 			shellEscape(fmt.Sprintf("%d", app.config.Port)),
554: 			shellEscape(electronPath), shellEscape(mainJsPath),
555: 		)
556: 		app.desktopCmd = exec.Command("sudo", "-u", sudoUser, "--set-home", "--", "bash", "-c", shellCmd)
557: 	} else {
558: 		app.desktopCmd = exec.Command(electronPath, "--disable-gpu", "--disable-software-rasterizer", mainJsPath)
559: 		app.desktopCmd.Env = append(os.Environ(),
560: 			fmt.Sprintf("KNIRV_SERVER_URL=%s", serverUrl),
561: 			fmt.Sprintf("KNIRV_SHUTDOWN_TOKEN=%s", app.shutdownToken),
562: 			fmt.Sprintf("KNIRV_SERVER_PORT=%d", app.config.Port),
563: 			"VK_ICD_FILENAMES=",
564: 			"ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT=auto",
565: 		)
566: 	}
567: 	app.desktopCmd.Dir = desktopDir
568: 	app.desktopCmd.Stdout = os.Stdout
569: 	app.desktopCmd.Stderr = os.Stderr
570: 
571: 	if err := app.desktopCmd.Start(); err != nil {
572: 		return fmt.Errorf("failed to start desktop: %w", err)
573: 	}
574: 
575: 	log.Printf("KNIRV Desktop started (PID: %d)", app.desktopCmd.Process.Pid)
576: 	return nil
577: }

749: func writeFileAtomically(path string, data []byte, perm os.FileMode) error {
750: 	dir := filepath.Dir(path)
751: 	if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0755); err != nil {
752: 		return err
753: 	}
754: 
755: 	tmp, err := os.CreateTemp(dir, "."+filepath.Base(path)+".tmp-*")
756: 	if err != nil {
757: 		return err
758: 	}
759: 	tmpPath := tmp.Name()
760: 	cleanup := true
761: 	defer func() {
762: 		if cleanup {
763: 			_ = os.Remove(tmpPath)
764: 		}
765: 	}()
766: 
767: 	if _, err := tmp.Write(data); err != nil {
768: 		_ = tmp.Close()
769: 		return err
770: 	}
771: 	if err := tmp.Chmod(perm); err != nil {
772: 		_ = tmp.Close()
773: 		return err
774: 	}
775: 	if err := tmp.Close(); err != nil {
776: 		return err
777: 	}
778: 	if err := os.Rename(tmpPath, path); err != nil {
779: 		return err
780: 	}
781: 
782: 	cleanup = false
783: 	return nil
784: }
